missions.name: Dead Stock Analysis by Category
missions.query: What are the top 3 product categories with the highest dead stock count across all locations?

missions.name: Sizing Anomaly Detection by Style
missions.query: Identify styles with inconsistent size distributions across different locations. (e.g., size 8 in one location is more common than size 10 in another location)

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Assessment by Country
missions.query: Analyze the lead time for suppliers by country and identify countries with consistently delayed shipments

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Analysis by Supplier
missions.query: For each supplier, identify products that have breached their reorder points in the last 3 months and calculate the total stockout value

missions.name: Sales Event Channel Analysis by Product Category
missions.query: Analyze the sales event channel distribution by product category and identify categories with uneven channel participation

missions.name: Inventory Location Analysis by Stock Count
missions.query: For each inventory location, calculate the average stock count and identify locations with significantly high or low stock counts

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate Analysis by Lead Time
missions.query: Analyze the on-time delivery rate for each supplier by lead time and identify suppliers with low on-time delivery rates

missions.name: Product Lifecycle Analysis by Sales Volume
missions.query: Analyze the sales volume distribution for products across their lifecycle (new, established, declining) and identify products with abnormal sales volume patterns
